This is the unmodified official mpv-player macOS 15 arm64 development archive
at commit `3aecc359b`, build `39997768869`. Its original download URL and SHA-256
are recorded in `work/native-dependencies.lock`. The rolling upstream release
removes old assets, so the verified archive is retained here for repeatable builds.

It contains the CoreAudio initialization failure fix
`c5d391adba7bd024954d0df1e0405f5749f4d4ca`. See `THIRD_PARTY.md` for the native
dependency licensing/provenance limitations.
